title: DC-area forecast: Muggy tonight with more storm chances this week
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Showers lingering south and east of the Beltway exit by around 7:30 p.m. Otherwise muggy 70s this evening. A couple of passing showers or a storm remain possible this evening and overnight.

What’s next? Shower and thunderstorm chances continue Tuesday and Wednesday, although perhaps not as stormy as today. Temperatures and humidity ease a bit mid- to late week, and more so by the weekend.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Mostly dry once lingering showers south and east of the Beltway exit to the east by around 7:30 p.m, although a couple of passing showers or a thunderstorm remain possible during the evening and overnight. Otherwise, expect a mostly cloudy and muggy summer night with lows from around 70 in the cooler suburbs to the mid-70s downtown. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): Variably cloudy, very warm, and a touch less humid, with highs in the upper 80s to near 90 (dew points in upper 60s to near 70). Showers and storms are probably fewer a farther between than today. But an isolated morning shower is possible, with the chance of a few showers and strong storms in the afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: A few showers and a storm remain possible. Otherwise, skies are mostly cloudy with muggy lows from 70 to 75. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Wednesday and Thursday look fairly similar, with partly sunny skies, continued moderate to high humidity and highs near 90. Each day brings a small chance of late afternoon and evening showers and thunderstorms, but lower chances than early in the week. Nights remain muggy, with lows generally between 70 and 75. Confidence: Medium

Friday could turn less hot and humid with lower storm chances, if a cold front moves far enough to our south. For now highs are anywhere from the 80s to near 90. Confidence: Low

The weekend should be somewhat less hot and humid as dew points fall into the 60s. Highs should mainly reach the mid-80s, with overnight lows in the mid-60s to near 70. Skies are generally partly sunny, with only a slight chance of an afternoon or evening shower or thunderstorm each day. Confidence: Low-Medium

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: With a chance to hit 95 degrees and storms possible, too, I wouldn't mind taking a pass on today's weather. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for August 10

A tragic 1943 lightning strike at Fort Belvoir killed six soldiers instantly, marking the deadliest lightning incident on record in the DC area.
